scripts.setup: bun install && bun run setup:client && bun run setup:server
scripts.setup:server: cd server && dotnet restore && dotnet tool restore
scripts.dev:server: cd server && dotnet watch run --launch-profile http
scripts.build: bun run build:client && bun run build:server
scripts.check: bun run check:client && bun run test:server
scripts.db:update: cd server && dotnet ef database update
scripts.db:migrations: cd server && dotnet ef migrations list
